name: brain_control
title: Flowork Brain Control
description: Manage, search, recall, and record atomic memories in the Sovereign Memory Vault (.fl_brain/). Case-insensitive path resolution across workspace and engine root. Use to recall past verified solutions, inspect historical bugfixes, or record new solutions (1 file 1 solution with at least 10 English keywords).
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

components.name: Live Memory Synapse Recall Box
components.description: In-chat ephemeral memory recall terminal querying .fl_brain permanent memory vault

components.name: Jarvis Active Synaptic HUD
components.description: Neural cognitive telemetry HUD with amber waveform monitor and progress scanner

components.name: Memory Synapse Code Stream
components.description: Frameless obsidian screen streaming synchronized working memory experiences

action.description: Memory action: 'search' (keyword/semantic query across memories), 'read' (fetch full memory file by id or slug), 'write' (atomically store verified solution with at least 10 keywords), 'list' (catalog stored memories), 'purge' (delete memory).

id.description: Unique memory ID or filename slug (for action: 'read', 'write', or 'purge').

keywords.description: Array of at least 10 technical keywords in English covering symptoms, tools, root causes, commands, and verified fixes (for action: 'write').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (for action: 'search' or 'list', default: 10).

overwrite.description: Set to true to overwrite existing memory with the same ID (for action: 'write').

problem.description: Detailed description of the issue, error logs, and context (for action: 'write').

query.description: Search query keywords or problem terms (for action: 'search').

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining WHY you are calling this tool right now and what specific action it performs (displayed live to the user on every tool HUD and used on the first call to recall up to 3 memories from .fl_brain).

root_cause.description: Optional root cause analysis explaining why the issue occurred (for action: 'write').

solution.description: The exact verified fix, configuration changes, or commands that produced Exit Code 0 (for action: 'write').

title.description: Technical descriptive title of the solution in English (for action: 'write').
